user.title: Connect a Nimly lock
user.description: Enter the lock's Zigbee2MQTT topic. The integration uses Home Assistant's existing MQTT connection.

abort.already_configured: This MQTT device is already configured

init.title: Bluetooth and owner key
init.description: Pick the lock's BLE address as Home Assistant (or its proxy) sees it. Owner key: {owner_key_state}. To import, paste the full content of owner-<address>.json from ~/.config/nimly-manager/ on the machine that enrolled the lock. The key is kept only in Home Assistant's private storage, never shown again and never included in diagnostics.

data.remove_owner_key: Delete the stored owner key (a lost key needs a module reset and a new Zigbee pairing)

error.invalid_ble_address: Enter a BLE address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
error.invalid_owner_record: The owner record is not a complete, enrolled owner-*.json
